YouTube 给的显示名，如「English (auto-generated): The display name YouTube gives it, e.g. "English (auto-generated)"
true = ASR 自动识别；false = 人工上传/校对过: true = auto-generated by ASR; false = manually uploaded or proofread
为真时可用「翻译成」把它转成下面任一语言: When true, "Translate to" can convert it into any of the languages below
为真表示这份文本是 YouTube 机翻的结果: When true, this text is the result of YouTube's machine translation
人工字幕排在自动生成的前面: Manual captions are ranked ahead of auto-generated ones
人工字幕质量明显更好但常常没有。「都行」= 同语言下人工优先，没有才用自动生成的: Manual captions are noticeably better quality but often unavailable. "Either" = prefer manual within the same language, falling back to auto-generated only if there's none
保留 <b> <i> 之类的内联标签。默认去掉——多数下游要的是纯文本: Keeps inline tags such as <b> and <i>. Stripped by default — most downstream uses want plain text
取任意公开 YouTube 视频的字幕，产出带时间轴的分句和拼好的全文。不需要: Fetches the transcript of any public YouTube video, producing timestamped segments and the assembled full text. No YouTube account or API …
各分句以空格拼接，已解转义、已去标签: Segments joined with spaces; unescaped and with tags stripped
填语言代码（如 zh-Hans）则用 YouTube 自带的机器翻译转一遍。**: Enter a language code (e.g. zh-Hans) to run it through YouTube's built-in machine translation. **The track is selected by the priority above first, then translated**; an error is raised if the selected track doesn't support translation
形如 `http://user:pass@host:port` 或 `socks: In the form `http://user:pass@host:port` or `socks5://host:1080`. **Essentially required when deployed in a data center or on a cloud host**: YouTube blocks data-center IPs with a 429 or a "confirm you're not a robot" challenge, and a residential proxy is currently the only reliable fix
拿一个公开视频试取一次字幕。本插件不需要账号，这里验的是**出站网络通不通、有没: Tries fetching the transcript of a public video once. This plugin needs no account — this check verifies **whether outbound network access works and whether YouTube is blocking the IP**
按语言优先级取一条字幕，产出带时间轴的分句 + 拼好的全文: Fetches a transcript by language priority, producing timestamped segments plus the assembled full text
方便直接接条件分支，不用在下游数数组: Convenient for wiring directly into a conditional branch, without counting the array downstream
最后一句的结束时刻；不等于视频总长: The end time of the last segment; not the same as the video's total length
留空用一个常见的桌面 Chrome UA: Leave empty to use a common desktop Chrome user agent
看这个视频有哪些语言的字幕、哪些是人工的、能翻译成什么: Shows what language transcripts this video has, which are manual, and what they can be translated to
视频 id 或任意 YouTube 链接：watch?v=… / youtu.b: A video id or any YouTube link: watch?v=…, youtu.be/…, shorts/…, embed/…, and live/… are all accepted; the 11-character id alone also works
逗号分隔，**按优先级从高到低**，如 `zh-Hans,zh,en`。取第一个: Comma-separated, **highest priority first**, e.g. `zh-Hans,zh,en`. The first match is used; empty = en. **Regional variants are recognized**: entering en also matches en-US / en-GB; within the same language family, manual captions are preferred before an exact code match
